scope: E31-A/B analytic diagnostics only; no training, new QKV, Test or cache changes

schemes.A0: E30 original mass-squared ridge; unchanged five features
schemes.A1: within each page and occurrence normalize sum_q mass^2 to 1; then pool occurrences; unchanged five features
schemes.A2: same event-balanced weighting as A1; replace last phi component (F index4) with raw variance feature sum_g softmax(R4 logits)_g sum_j ||q_blockj||^2/128 * stats[g,j]; no extra dimensions or fitted rescaling

ridge: E26 fixed relative ridge 1e-6 * trace(XtX)/5; existing train bscale; never tune on actions
current_pages: All cross-context methods keep the identical E30 original OracleCoeff64 beta on current pages, isolating historical reuse. Event-local fits of A2 saved for history; no current feature-change confound.
main_modes: Shared all matched appearances including target
LOTO all other matched appearances excluding target Q64

donor_categories.tile: same chunk and denoising step, different Query tile
donor_categories.forward: strictly earlier chunk of same physical page, any saved step/tile; never future donor

missing_donors: Use E29 predicted beta on uncovered history pages; all categories share original event-teacher current pages. Report coverage and covered-event subset.
matched_support: For each held event, intersect historical pages with donors in all three categories; evaluate each category on same support, baseline prediction elsewhere.
B_quality: sum_qp m^2*(beta-beta_true)^2, plus divide by sum weights; all/candidate/background separately; M16 main and Q64 regression checks
B_decision: Frozen E29 predicted response; TrueBeta teacher gain scores. Equal state/action weights; Huber with each teacher-state RMS floored by existing training gscale, plus 0.1 listwise KL including no-op, identical teacher/student temperature0.3 (exact teacher has zero loss). No loss fitting or updates.
primary_inference: M16, positive predicted gain or no-op, Q64 real NMSE; reuse E25 five-state common legal panel
continuation: No automatic training. Report both-seed LOTO changes vs E30 A0 and E29; same-info Independent, degradation/P10/worst, conditional correlation. Successful regression alone is insufficient.
numerics: E30 separate logsumexp positive mixtures, unbounded beta retained; no clipping or deleted events
